title: Familial Clan Court — Relations With Neighbours

entries.value: Isolated — distrusted or disliked by most neighbours
Creditor — many neighbours owe them money or favours
Scorned — derided for some deed or trait
Respected — honoured for military prowess, justice, or piety
Newcomers — relatively recently arrived in the area
Loners — not disliked, but not close to anyone
Feared — for past acts or the present threat they represent
Revered — held in awe by most of the community
Loved — widely adored by other families and tenants
Needed — for a particular skill, service, or person
Hated — barely endured by their neighbours
